title: IT helpdesk migration — from shared inboxes to ticketing

facts.text: Requests are raised from a web portal, email or the intranet
One queue with hardware, software, access, network and other categories
Staff can see only their own tickets
Escalation to the on-call engineer after 8 business hours
Security incidents go straight to the on-call engineer
Sign-in is Google Workspace single sign-on
Searchable self-service knowledge base of the twenty most common fixes
The last 12 months of email are imported
Manager dashboard with volume, first response and resolution time
No mobile app — the portal is responsive
groups: not include the development of a mobile

facts.text: Resolved tickets are retained for 3 years
Access granted through the Google Workspace directory group, removed within 15 minutes
A ticket closed without requester confirmation after 5 business days closes automatically
